summary: Design baselines, monitoring plans, and verification-ready evidence for carbon projects. Explore the practical MRV course from TrainingCred.
lede: Carbon project MRV training helps developers, consultants, auditors and public-sector teams build evidence for project claims. Participants practise defining project boundaries and baselines, developing monitoring plans, tracking data quality and uncertainty, and organizing verification records using ISO 14064-2, ISO 14064-3 and the GHG Protocol Project Protocol. Digital MRV, geospatial review and remote-sensing applications receive operational overview-level treatment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for carbon project design, field monitoring, data management, assurance, or public programme oversight. It is suited to people who need to build or review project evidence against recognized GHG accounting and verification practices.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with carbon projects, greenhouse gas data, environmental monitoring, or assurance is recommended. No programming is required. You should bring a laptop if you plan to use spreadsheet or GIS exercises; QGIS is a free, open-source option for the GIS exercises, and the spreadsheet work uses Microsoft Excel.
